name: The Garage
summary: The real, active reselling workflow, multi-platform (eBay, Vinted, Poshmark, Depop). New: an AI photo-to-listing drafter (Claude vision + live web-search comp research), upload real item photos and it drafts a title, category, condition notes, description, comp-researched price, and shipping dimensions, each field with a confidence level and reasoning, human-reviewed before anything is pasted into listings.json, nothing auto-publishes. Tested end to end against a real never-listed item (TY Beanie Baby) with a genuine 9/19 draft run. Recently published 9 live listings across all four platforms, plus a full photo audit of 48 Depop drafts that caught and fixed a real bad cover photo and a return-policy bug blocking eBay publishes. Supersedes the old standalone Reselling cluster, which tracked a manual spreadsheet workflow Jack has since moved off of.
